name: MiDaS
paper_title: Towards Robust Monocular Depth Estimation: Mixing Datasets for Zero-shot Cross-dataset Transfer
license_interpretation: The isl-org/MiDaS repository, code and released checkpoints included, is MIT. LibreYOLO's own port code is MIT as well. LibreYOLO does not republish the checkpoints on its own Hugging Face organization, though: the family downloads the two official release assets directly from GitHub and checks them against a pinned SHA-256 before wrapping them, because an internal LibreYOLO policy (ADR 0006) requires the training-dataset mixture's commercial-redistribution terms to be cleared before LibreYOLO hosts a depth checkpoint itself, and that clearance has not happened for MiDaS. The bytes you get are upstream's own MIT-licensed release either way.

bibtex_verified: 2026-08-08, copied verbatim from the Citation section of the upstream README on branch master. Two entries apply to LibreYOLO's port: Ranftl2022 ("cite our paper if you use this code or any of the models") and Ranftl2021, which the README asks for specifically "if you use a DPT-based model", true here for the l size (DPT-Large). The README's third entry, the MiDaS v3.1 technical report, is asked for only when using MiDaS 3.1 models; LibreYOLO's l checkpoint is the earlier v3 dpt_large_384 release, so that entry is left out. Cross-checked against the arXiv API: 1907.01341 lists the same five authors in the same order, published 2019-07-02, matching Ranftl2022's author list; 2103.13413 lists the same three authors in the same order, published 2021-03-24, matching Ranftl2021. The Ranftl2021 entry is copied as the authors wrote it even though its venue field holds a bare conference name ("ICCV") in an @article type rather than @inproceedings. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.
